facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy saw a yellow road. She started walking on it. Toto walked with her. She followed the road.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy stood at the beginning of the yellow brick road. The golden bricks sparkled in the bright sunshine. She followed the road with Toto running beside her. Beautiful flowers and tall trees lined both sides of the path. The road was very long but Dorothy did not give up. She knew the Wizard was waiting at the end.
facts.Word cards: followed = 따라갔다 / road = 길 / yellow = 노란 / brick = 벽돌
